title: Google Maps Directions Scraper
description: Compare route alternatives for one or more origin and destination pairs. Maximum 10 unique routes per run.

routes.title: Routes
routes.description: Preferred batch input. One request is created for each route object; duplicate requests are processed once. Maximum 10 route requests per run.

origin.title: Origin
origin.description: Starting address, place name, or coordinates.

destination.title: Destination
destination.description: Ending address, place name, or coordinates.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Travel mode: driving, walking, bicycling/cycling, or transit.

hl.title: Language
hl.description: Language code for route labels, such as en or de-DE.

gl.title: Region
gl.description: Two-letter country or region code for geo-filtering.
